飓风佣兵队从出现到成名仅仅用了半个月，之后就常年霸占着排行榜的第一名。

而这个不服来战中二病佣兵队，它出名的时候，就已经在排行榜上了，之前没有任何人听过这个佣兵队。

这种情况只能说明他们接的任务都是只需要一个佣兵队就能完全的任务，才能保证不和其他人接触。

但是这种任务奖励向来不多，很少有佣兵队去接，都是没有组织的异能者临时组队，或则单独一个人完成。

接这种任务，还让佣兵队没有生存下去，可见人家还是有几分本事的。

几个月的末世生活教给他们一个道理，千万不要小看女人和孩子。

常新深呼吸一口气，“顾队长，这次任务需要绝对的保密，我希望你能给我一个明确的答案。如果你拒绝回答，那么我只能将你们击杀在此。”

他给了身边的人一个手势，立即有人将时笙几人围了起来。

其他的人则退到了旁边，用看好戏的神情，事不关己的看着。

“常队长！”清玉连忙站了出去，然而他后面的话还没说出来，就被时笙拉了回来。

“老大，他们人多，我们还是先低头吧。”清玉知道时笙此时火大，但是现在这里这么多异能者，他们处于劣势。

“低头？”时笙冷哼，一脸的倨傲，“重来只有别人给我低头的份，何时轮到我给别人低头了。”

清玉：“……”拜托，老大你中二也选个时间好不好。

时笙的声音不算小，不但常新听到了，就连外面的人都听到了。

外面的人还有人吹口哨，显然是被时笙这种不怕死的行为给取悦了。

这种小女生，他们见多了，以为这还是末世前，有点钱就能让人围着自己转吗？现在是拿实力说话的世道。

这个神神秘秘的不服来战，也不过如此嘛！

不过更多人想的是，这几个小年轻背后还有人。

气氛顿时剑拔弩张起来。

“啊！快跑，丧尸进来了。”突兀的声音打破了这诡异的气氛。

这声音是从二楼传来的，常队长放弃和时笙对话，抬头往二楼看去，几道人影从二楼飞奔下来，戚明雪和宋拾都在其中。

果然是女主走到哪儿，哪儿就要出事啊！

他们身后跟着一只喷火的丧尸，时笙微微皱眉，这只丧尸，不是之前那只。

握草！这里有几只四级丧尸？

It only took half a month for the Hurricane Mercenaries to become famous, and since then they have occupied the top spot in the rankings all year round.

As for the mercenary team of Unsatisfied to Fight Chuunibyou, when it became famous, it was already on the rankings. No one had heard of this mercenary team before.

This situation can only show that the tasks they take on are tasks that only one mercenary team can complete, so as to ensure that they do not come into contact with other people.

However, there are never many rewards for this kind of mission. There are very few mercenary teams to take it. They are all temporarily formed by unorganized superpowers, or they are completed by one person alone.

Accepting this kind of mission, but also preventing the mercenary team from surviving, it shows that they are still somewhat capable.

A few months of apocalyptic life taught them one lesson: never underestimate women and children.

Chang Xin took a deep breath and said, "Captain Gu, this mission requires absolute confidentiality. I hope you can give me a clear answer. If you refuse to answer, then I can only kill you here."

He gave a gesture to the people around him, and someone immediately surrounded Shi Sheng and others.

The other people retreated to the side, watching as if they were watching a good show, as if it had nothing to do with themselves.

"Captain Chang!" Qingyu quickly stood up, but before he could say the next words, he was pulled back by Shi Sheng.

"Boss, there are many of them, let's bow our heads first." Qingyu knew that Shi Sheng was furious at this time, but now that there are so many people with powers here, they are at a disadvantage.

"Bow down?" Shi Sheng snorted coldly, with a look of arrogance on his face, "In the future, only others will bow down to me. When will it be my turn to bow down to others?"

Qingyu: "..." Please, boss, can you also choose a time for the second grade?

Shi Sheng's voice was not quiet. Not only Chang Xin heard it, but also people outside heard it.

Some people outside were whistling, obviously pleased by Shi Sheng's unafraid behavior.

They have seen this kind of little girl so many times, do they think this is still before the end of the world, and with a little money, people can surround themselves?Now is the world where strength speaks for itself.

This mysterious unwillingness to fight is nothing more than that!

But what more people think about is that there are people behind these young people.

The atmosphere suddenly became tense.

"Ah! Run, the zombies are coming in." A sudden voice broke the weird atmosphere.

The sound came from the second floor. Captain Chang gave up talking to Shi Sheng and looked up to the second floor. Several figures flew down from the second floor, including Qi Mingxue and Song Shi.

As expected, wherever the heroine goes, something will happen!

Behind them was a fire-breathing zombie. Shi Sheng frowned slightly. This zombie was not the previous one.

Hold the grass!How many level four zombies are there?
